locations.name: Brindle Ford

narrative.overview: Brindle Ford is a muddy, cheerful river town built around a ferry rope as thick as your arm. The Guildhall flies a lantern banner, the Quill & Candle sells everything, and the Watch House has a very loud bell. Out past the estuary, the lighthouse on Gull Rock stands dark.
narrative.shortDescription: A river-crossing town of ferries, gossip and mud.

locations.rumour: Brindle Ford: where the river road crosses the Brindle. Everyone passes through sooner or later.

criticalDiscovery.title: Lost Under the Ferry Steps
criticalDiscovery.narrative: Wedged between the ferry steps you spot a dropped purse and a twist of smelling salts. Finders keepers.

hiddenSpots.name: a loose cobble
hiddenSpots.text: One cobble by the Guildhall rocks underfoot. Someone's emergency savings are tucked beneath it.

hiddenSpots.name: a crate under the ferry dock
hiddenSpots.text: Under the dock, out of the rain, someone has stashed a bottle of Saltreed brandy. No stamp, of course.

tactics.label: Use the market crowd
tactics.desc: Slip between stalls and strike from where you are not expected.
tactics.text: You vanish among the carts and come out swinging.

actions.title: Read the Guild notice board
actions.desc: Jobs, warnings and a very rude drawing of the Watch captain.

transcript.speaker: Notice Board
transcript.text: URGENT: Pip Tallow, the lamplighter's apprentice, went up Thornback Ridge yesterday to look at the dark lighthouse and has not come back. Storm due. See Captain Garrow. ALSO: Bounty on the thing in the Old Moss. ALSO: Whoever keeps stealing the Guild's pencils, stop.

addJournalKnowledge.title: The Notice Board
addJournalKnowledge.text: Pip Tallow is stranded on Thornback Ridge with a storm coming. There is a bounty on a creature in the Old Moss.

actions.title: Arm-wrestle the bargemen
actions.desc: Five drachmae on the table. A pure test of Strength.

transcript.speaker: The Ferry Inn
transcript.text: Big Nell's arm hits the table with a bang. The whole inn cheers and pays up.

failure.text: Nell slams your hand down so hard the mugs jump. 'Come back when you've eaten something,' she grins.
failure.speaker: The Ferry Inn

criticalSuccess.text: You win so fast that Nell buys you a drink and a second purse is pushed your way.

criticalFailure.text: Something pops in your shoulder. You spend half an hour with your arm in a bucket of cold water.

locations.name: Willowmere Apiary

narrative.overview: Hundreds of straw hives hum among the willows. The Hive Sisters move between them in veils, and at the centre of the garden the Hive Mother's shrine stones glisten with spilled honey.
narrative.shortDescription: A humming monastery garden of hives and healers.

locations.rumour: Willowmere: the Hive Sisters heal anyone who asks politely.

hiddenSpots.name: a comb cellar
hiddenSpots.text: Behind the shrine is a cool cellar of old honeycomb, and a forgotten bottle of mead.

actions.title: Pour mead on the shrine stones
actions.desc: An offering to the Hive Mother. She likes the good stuff.

transcript.speaker: The Hive Mother
transcript.text: The mead soaks into the warm stones. Every bee in the garden hums one note, and your tiredness lifts.

actions.title: Ask the Sisters for a blessing
actions.desc: After an offering, the Sisters will bless travellers once.

transcript.speaker: Sister Bramble
transcript.text: A Sister dabs honey on your forehead and mutters something about patience. You feel ready for anything (+2 on your next check).

actions.title: Cast the augury bones
actions.desc: Four bones, one cup, the Hive Mother's opinion of your day.

successOutcome.text: A Sister nods at your cast. 'She is watching you,' she says, which is either nice or worrying.
successOutcome.speaker: Willowmere

locations.name: The Old Moss

narrative.overview: Black pools, cotton-grass and duckweed as far as you can see. Grandmother Rook's stilt hut leans over the water, and in the middle of the bog a single standing stone leans the other way, as if the two are arguing.
narrative.shortDescription: A wide, sucking peat bog full of secrets and hares.

locations.rumour: The Old Moss: a bog with a talking stone and something under the duckweed.

hiddenSpots.name: a drowned pedlar's pack
hiddenSpots.text: Half sunk in a pool is a pedlar's pack. The coins are fine; the pedlar, presumably, is not.

hiddenSpots.name: an old boardwalk
hiddenSpots.text: Under a mat of sedge you find rotting planks: an old boardwalk heading south toward the sea. It would take you straight to Saltreed Cove.

addJournalKnowledge.title: The Old Boardwalk
addJournalKnowledge.text: A hidden boardwalk links the Old Moss and Saltreed Cove.

hiddenSpots.name: wisp-glass in the reeds
hiddenSpots.text: Something glints green among the reeds: a shard of wisp-glass, still warm.

tactics.label: Lure it into the sucking mud
tactics.desc: Draw your foe onto the soft ground where it flounders.
tactics.text: Your foe sinks to the knees in black mud and thrashes.

actions.title: Stalk bog hares in the reeds
actions.desc: Step only when the wind rattles the reeds. A good meal if you are patient.

minigameConfig.subTitle: Bog hares: quick ears, quicker legs

actions.title: Read the Bog Stone
actions.desc: The leaning stone has a riddle cut into it, and a causeway of black stones sunk below it.

locations.name: Saltreed Cove

narrative.overview: A crescent of grey shingle hidden by reed beds. Upturned boats, tarred sheds and a lot of crates that say FISH but clink. Across the water, Gull Rock and its dead lighthouse.
narrative.shortDescription: A smugglers' cove of shingle, reeds and crates that clink.

locations.rumour: Saltreed Cove: officially a fishing beach. Unofficially, Jory Vane's.

hiddenSpots.name: a tide pool
hiddenSpots.text: In a tide pool, among the anemones, an oyster gapes around a lumpy pearl.

tactics.label: Fight with the sea at your back
tactics.desc: Wait for a breaker to hit your foe first.
tactics.text: A wave knocks your foe sprawling as you charge.

locations.name: Thornback Ridge

narrative.overview: A razor ridge of gorse and grey rock running out to the sea cliffs. The wind never stops. Far below, Gull Rock stands in the surf, and somewhere above you a gryphon screams.
narrative.shortDescription: A windy ridge of gorse, ledges and big birds.

locations.rumour: Thornback Ridge: gorse, goats and a gryphon. Pip Tallow went up there and has not come down.

hiddenSpots.name: a cliff stair
hiddenSpots.text: Behind a gorse thicket, steps cut into the cliff zigzag down toward Gull Rock. A gryphon's nest sits right above them, and its owner is home.

tactics.label: Start a rockslide
tactics.desc: Lever a boulder loose above your foe.
tactics.text: Stones thunder down the slope onto your foe!

actions.title: Climb down to Pip's ledge
actions.desc: Pip is stuck on a ledge below the path. A climb, no rope.

transcript.speaker: Rescue
transcript.text: Hand over hand you reach the ledge. Pip grabs your arm like a limpet. 'I knew someone would come! Mostly knew. Hoped.'

failure.text: The rock crumbles under your fingers and you scramble back up, heart pounding. Better catch your breath before trying again.
failure.speaker: Narrator

criticalFailure.text: You slip and slide twenty feet before a gorse bush catches you. It takes half an hour to pick out the thorns.

actions.title: Lower a rope to Pip
actions.desc: Tie off a rope and let Pip climb up. Safe and boring.

transcript.speaker: Rescue
transcript.text: You lash the rope to a rock and Pip shins up it, babbling thanks the whole way.

actions.title: Search the storm caves for Pip
actions.desc: The storm drove Pip off the ledge into the caves. Find the right one.

skillCheck.name: Follow Pip's trail into the caves

transcript.speaker: Rescue
transcript.text: Chalk marks on the rock, shaped like little lanterns. Pip left a trail. You find the apprentice wrapped in a sailcloth, very cold and very glad to see you.

failure.text: Every cave looks the same and the wind howls through all of them. You will have to warm up and try again.
failure.speaker: Narrator

locations.name: Gull Rock Lighthouse

narrative.overview: A stump of black rock crusted with gulls and barnacles. The lighthouse tower is white with salt, its great lantern dark. The door is shut, and from somewhere inside, a bell tolls by itself.
narrative.shortDescription: A dark lighthouse on a rock in the surf.

locations.rumour: Gull Rock: the lighthouse that went dark. The keeper went inside and never came out.

hiddenSpots.name: a storm locker
hiddenSpots.text: Bolted to the rock is the keeper's storm locker. Inside: dry matches, a tonic and a note that says DO NOT GO DOWN TO THE BELL.

actions.title: Relight the lantern with the Everflame
actions.desc: Climb to the lantern room and set the Everflame wick in its cradle.

transcript.speaker: Gull Rock
transcript.text: The wick catches with a sound like a held breath let go. Light pours out over the sea, the fog tears open, and from the shore you hear the ferry bell ringing and ringing.

addJournalChronicle.title: The Lantern Burns
addJournalChronicle.text: Relit the Gull Rock lantern with the Everflame. Lanternfall is over.

locations.name: The Sunken Chapel

narrative.overview: Half a chapel rises from the bog, its nave full of black water. Barnacles on the walls, though the sea is miles away. On the altar a carved lantern, and blue lights drifting where the congregation used to sit.
narrative.shortDescription: A drowned chapel of the Tide Warden, haunted by wisps.

locations.rumour: The Sunken Chapel: the Tide Warden's old church, swallowed by the bog.

criticalDiscovery.title: A Ring in the Font
criticalDiscovery.narrative: In the old font, under green water, a ring set with wisp-glass glows faintly. It slides onto your finger like it was waiting.

actions.title: Offer a pearl at the altar
actions.desc: The Tide Warden liked pearls. So say the carvings.

transcript.speaker: The Tide Warden
transcript.text: The pearl rolls into the carved lantern and the wisps all turn toward you at once. Then they bow. You feel the old sea-power notice you.
